name: Isabel Costa
bio:
Isabel Costa's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly, after a career in corporate communications. A chance encounter at a local rally sparked a passion that led her to transition her skills to the high-octane environment of racing. Initially managing communications for a small karting team, Isabel quickly proved her ability to navigate the complex world of motorsport PR. Her keen eye for detail and understanding of media relations were invaluable.

Now at Rexal FMI Racing, Isabel is responsible for crafting and maintaining the team's public image. She prides herself on her proactive approach, always seeking opportunities to highlight the team's achievements and build relationships with key media outlets. Isabel is known for her demanding nature, pushing for excellence in every aspect of her work. Her ability to blend strategic thinking with hands-on execution makes her a valuable asset to the team, ensuring their message resonates with fans and sponsors alike.

Isabel's distinctive approach comes from her commitment to authenticity. She believes in telling the real stories behind the races, highlighting the dedication and passion of the team members. This commitment, combined with her extensive network and sharp communication skills, sets her apart in the competitive world of motorsport PR.

physical.description: Isabel is a woman of medium height with a warm, engaging smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with press contacts and story ideas.
Has a penchant for espresso, drinking multiple cups throughout the day.
Insists on reviewing all press releases at least three times before publication.
